allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of listing approval letters for the issue of 34,68,007 equity shares to Kirloskar Power Equipments Limited, a promoter group Company by way of preferential issue.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited has informed the Exchange about consolidation of the objects of the proposed preferential issue of equity shares of the Company.
